visualCharacteristics: Grid of bordered tiles (3-up desktop), image or icon on top, title and text below; optional heading/intro row; Style options solutions, productlines, insights, simple, features, products (single column: large product image, H3 title, Read More button), contentlist (3-up borderless cards: bordered 4:3 image linked to the title href, light 22.4px H3, linked description with chevron; 1-up without image below 768px), icon-left (2-up from 992px: ~70px icon beside bold title, text and a solid red button; stacked and centered below), buttons (centered wrapping 265px red tiles, white 50px icon left of the label, whole tile is the link; external links open in a new tab), thumblist (1-up, 2-up from 992px with a 48px row gap: 90px cover-cropped square thumbnail always left of the text with a 25px gap, uppercase 16px/700 black title, 16px/26.4px #333 description; the title link is stretched over the whole tile, hover turns the tile text blue and dims the other tiles).
reuseGuidance: Use for wrapping grids of look-alike linked items with an image or icon.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: optional heading/intro text; then one row per card: image or icon cell, text cell with linked title (H3/H4) and description

options.label: Products (large image + H3 title + Read More button)
Content List (3-up: bordered 4:3 image, light H3, linked text)
Icon Left (2-up: small icon beside bold title, text, red button)
Buttons (red link tiles with white icon)
Thumb List (2-up: 90px square thumbnail left of uppercase title and text)
